acceptance: Explicit finite setting estimator of the complex connected difference with sample confidence at one predeclared q/time; do not assert simultaneous all-q/all-time confidence
Actual commutator/domain or other valid regularity proof for physical timing error; no norm continuity claim for arbitrary unbounded generators
At least one numerical sufficient resource budget with exact or enclosed arithmetic; no fabricated apparatus/simulated observations
Computed ancilla/sign or sequential wrong-model control, excessive error rejection and nondeterministic-sampling distinction
model: Canonical summable full-link SU(2), actual fixed U1 W and stationary states, V1 conditional coherent readout
parameters: Classify sample count/confidence, state-preparation/instrument error and timing uncertainty separately; none changes action or fitted clock.
review: Independent forward/reverse frozen before skeptic review; completion may be limited or insufficient; no continuum/priority inference.
scales: Fixed a,E_star,alpha/E_star,hbar>0; eta in (0,1); endpoint T=C hbar/alpha (1-q)^(-3); 0<z=C eta<=10^-6
target: Finite-sample endpoint readout with an explicit confidence, systematic-error and physical-clock budget; retain the actual full-system generator and disclose whether the sufficient resources are practical.
